claim_text: The Anwar Adow information charges Counts 1–4 of wire fraud under 18 U.S.C. § 1343, alleging interstate emails using PlusLibertyLLC@gmail.com from in or about March 2022 through in or about April 2025. Forfeiture is pleaded as to Count 1. A docket change-of-plea on 2025-10-23 is not a judgment and does not make these counts ADJUDICATED.

supporting_passages.quote: caused to be transmitted by means of wire communication in interstate commerce certain signals and sounds, including emails using the email account PlusLibertyLLC@gmail.com, all in violation of 18 U.S.C. § 1343.
